# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security-sensitive fixes are considered for the current stable release and the
active development branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue containing exploit details, credentials,
private data, or other sensitive information.

If GitHub private vulnerability reporting is available for this repository, use
that channel. Otherwise contact the package maintainer using the contact
information listed in `DESCRIPTION`.

For ordinary software bugs that do not involve sensitive information, use the
public bug-report issue form.
